supporting_observations.claim: A large outbound transfer of approximately 51 MB occurred from WS-ICHEN-01 to the internal proxy server (10.40.20.30) at 13:45:58 UTC.
The destination address 10.40.20.30 corresponds to PROXY-NWD-01, the organization's approved explicit web proxy.

The activity at the time of the alert was consistent with standard web browsing via the approved proxy, as evidenced by subsequent Chrome browser activity by user ivy.chen to approved domains like aws.amazon.com.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon logs for WS-ICHEN-01 and Proxy logs for PROXY-NWD-01 were not collected between 13:30 and 14:10 UTC due to a log collection outage.
claims_not_established: The exact content of the 51 MB transfer cannot be determined because proxy logs for that specific timestamp were not collected.
unrelated_findings: ZSATunnel.exe was started on WS-ICHEN-01 at 14:12:33 UTC, which is not listed as approved software in the environment context (T039-00264, T039-00265).
